entities.summary: Eugène Auguste Nicolas Millon was a French chemist and physician. He is remembered in the name of Millon's reagent which reacts with tyrosine in proteins to form a brown precipitate. The reagent is used for determination of the presence of soluble proteins.

entities.summary: Eugène Auguste Nicolas Millon was a French chemist and physician. He is remembered in the name of Millon's reagent which reacts with tyrosine in proteins to form a brown precipitate. The reagent is used for determination of the presence of soluble proteins.
